articles.description: Irish musician Glen Hansard died in a motorbike crash on July 29, 2026. He was 56 years old when the accident occurred near Strawberry Beds. articles.title: 268 feet tall, 1,600 years old: Meet the second-largest tree in the world. Travellers can hike through towering giant sequoias to reach this natural marvel
articles.description: The General Grant Tree, located in Kings Canyon National Park, California, stands as the world's second-largest tree, over 1,600 years old. This giant sequoia was proclaimed the Nation's Christmas Tree in 1926. Later, President Eisenhower designated it a National Shrine for fallen servicemen. The accessible General Grant Loop Trail showcases this living monument and historical sites. Visitors can explore the Fallen Monarch, Gamlin Cabin, and Centennial Stump along the path.

articles.description: Veronique Zidane, born Veronique Fernandez Lentisco on November 10, 1971, in Rodez, France, is the wife of newly appointed France head coach Zinedine Zidane. Of Spanish-Andalusian descent, she pursued dance at the prestigious Rosella Hightower School in Cannes before stepping away from professional life to raise the couple's four sons, all of whom went on to play professional football. She and Zinedine met in 1989 in Salon-de-Provence and married in 1994. Known for maintaining a deliberately private life with no verified social media presence, Veronique has remained a foundational but quiet figure throughout one of football's most celebrated careers

articles.title: Vishal's Makutam Unveils the Soulful New Song "Kalatheylaa"
articles.description: Makutam, the 99th production of Super Good Films, stars Vishal in the lead while also marking his directorial venture. Produced under the banner of the late R.B. Choudary, the film features Anjali and Dushara Vijayan as the female leads. The teaser, first single "The Rise of Linga," and the folk number "Nachake Vachera" have already raised expectations for the film. Continuing the momentum, the makers have now released another beautiful track titled "Kalatheylaa." "Kalatheylaa" is an emotional family-oriented motivational song that highlights heartwarming moments featuring Vishal, Dushara Vijayan, and children. Penned by Rajashree Sudhakar and sung by Krishna Tejasvi, the song is elevated by G.V. Prakash Kumar's catchy and soulful composition. With its appealing melody and emotional visuals, the song is expected to strike a chord with audiences and trend widely on YouTube. The film's cinematography is handled by Richard M. Nathan and Abhinandan Ramanujam, while N.B. Srikanth serves as the editor. The makers are expected to announce the film's release date soon. Cast : Vishal, Anjali, Dushara Vijayan, John Vijay, Jayaprakash, Ajay, Vamsi Krishna, Abu Salim, Arjai, Jhansi, Padam Kumar, Sabumon and others. Technical Crew: Banner: Super Good Films Producers: B. Suresh, R.B. Jeevan Choudary, Jithan Ramesh, Jeeva Presented by: R.B. Choudary Screenplay & Director: Vishal Directors of Photography: Richard M. Nathan & Abhinandan Ramanujam Music: G.V.
